requirements_summary: Mobile-first multiplayer/social game. Core need: low-latency streaming chat (player-to-player), inline moderation (spam/abuse detection) with automated takedown hooks, ability to route non-sensitive traffic to cheaper model for cost control. Target latency: p95 <100ms, p99 <150-200ms depending on region. Expected steady-state concurrent users for first release: 300-800; burst peaks up to 2k. Wants server-side token accounting, per-user rate limits, and retention/deletion controls for GDPR compliance.
